flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key of the HR service project this flow watches.

flowVariables.name: REQUEST_ISSUE_TYPE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira work item type name of the request.

flowVariables.name: REQUEST_TYPE_NAME
flowVariables.instruction: JSM request type name for employee change requests. Leave empty to accept every request of REQUEST_ISSUE_TYPE in the project; only do that if no other request type uses the same work item type and approved status.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_REQUEST_TYPE_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Field ID of the JSM Customer Request Type field (Settings > Issues > Custom fields), for example customfield_10010. Only read when REQUEST_TYPE_NAME is set.

flowVariables.name: APPROVED_STATUS_NAME
flowVariables.instruction: Jira status name the request moves to when its approval completes. The flow runs once, on the transition into this status.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_PERSONIO_PERSON_ID_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the Personio employee ID. Optional but preferred: when it holds a value the employee is looked up by ID, and when it is empty the ID found by email is written into it.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_EMPLOYEE_EMAIL_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the email of the employee being changed. Required. Used when the Personio employee ID field is empty.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_POSITION_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the new position / job title. Optional; leave empty to never send this value.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_DEPARTMENT_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the new department. Optional; leave empty to never send this value. Mapped through DEPARTMENT_ID_MAP.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_OFFICE_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the new office. Optional; leave empty to never send this value. Mapped through OFFICE_ID_MAP.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_WEEKLY_HOURS_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the new weekly working hours. Optional; leave empty to never send this value. A Jira number field.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_SUPERVISOR_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the new supervisor. Optional; leave empty to never send this value. A user picker or a text field holding the supervisor's Personio email.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_LEGAL_ENTITY_FIELD
flowVariables.instruction: Jira field ID holding the new legal entity (subcompany). Optional; leave empty to never send this value. Mapped through LEGAL_ENTITY_ID_MAP.

flowVariables.name: DEPARTMENT_ID_MAP
flowVariables.instruction: Jira department value to Personio department org unit ID, as Label=ID pairs separated by ;, for example Engineering=943;Sales=944. Empty sends the Jira value unchanged as the ID.

flowVariables.name: OFFICE_ID_MAP
flowVariables.instruction: Jira office value to Personio office ID, as Label=ID pairs separated by ;. Empty sends the Jira value unchanged as the ID.

flowVariables.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID_MAP
flowVariables.instruction: Jira legal entity value to Personio legal entity ID, as Label=ID pairs separated by ;. Empty sends the Jira value unchanged as the ID.

flowVariables.name: PERSONIO_API_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Personio API v2 base URL. No trailing slash.

flowVariables.name: JIRA_COMMENTS_INTERNAL
flowVariables.instruction: true posts the result comments as JSM internal notes; false makes them visible to the requester. Must be true or false.
